text:
I understand you're upset—a damaged order is frustrating. I'm here to help.

Since your refund is over $150, this needs to be escalated to a Support Lead who has the authority to review your situation fully. **They'll be able to assess the damage and process your refund.**

To get started, please reply with:
1. Your order number
2. Photos of the damaged item(s) and packaging (if you haven't already reported this within **48 hours** of delivery)
3. A brief description of what's damaged

I'll escalate this right away. If you reported the damage within 48 hours, we may have already flagged it as Damaged on Arrival, which has a faster resolution path.
